title: Technical Support Engineer (In Office) Kingston
description: Technical Support Engineer (In Office) Kingston Innovative Corporate Solutions Kingston and St. Andrew Not disclosed Fixed term contract Updated 03/11/2026 HR Manager Apply Now Share Share this job Facebook Twitter Report This Job Save Save We are seeking a skilled Technical Support Engineer to provide remote and on-site IT support in Kingston. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience with Microsoft 365, Active Directory, Windows Server, VMware and Veeam, with strong troubleshooting and customer service skills. Location: Kingston Job Type: Full-Time | In Office General Accountability / Purpose of the Position The Technical Support Engineer provides technical support to clients and internal staff. The role involves troubleshooting technical issues, managing service requests, supporting Microsoft 365 and Windows Server environments, and performing routine virtualisation, backup and security operations. Key Responsibilities Technical Support Install, configure and troubleshoot computer hardware, operating systems, software applications and peripherals. Diagnose and resolve technical incidents involving hardware, software, networking and system access. Manage assigned tickets through resolution, ensuring compliance with Service Level Agreements (SLAs). Provide remote and on-site support, including client visits and technical assessments. Escalate complex issues to the appropriate technical teams with supporting documentation. Systems Administration & Microsoft 365 Manage user accounts, groups, permissions and access within Active Directory and Microsoft Entra ID. Troubleshoot Windows Server, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP and authentication issues. Administer Microsoft 365 accounts, licences, mailboxes and applications, including Outlook, Teams, OneDrive and SharePoint. Support multi-factor authentication (MFA), email configuration and user connectivity issues. Virtualisation, Backup & Security Monitor VMware vSphere environments and perform routine virtual machine operations. Conduct daily Veeam Backup & Replication checks, troubleshoot backup failures and perform system restores. Monitor antivirus and endpoint security applications, addressing or escalating identified issues. Apply IT security best practices and follow established change management procedures. Quality Assurance & Communication Maintain accurate ticket records, technical documentation and operational reports. Provide timely updates to customers and follow up to confirm successful resolution. Adhere to company procedures, service standards and escalation protocols. Participate in technical training and continuous professional development. Knowledge, Skills & Abilities Strong troubleshooting, analytical and problem-solving skills. Excellent written and verbal communication and customer service skills. Ability to work independently, prioritise tasks and meet SLAs. Working knowledge of networking fundamentals, IT security and Microsoft technologies. Strong organisational skills, attention to detail and ability to work in a fast-paced environment. Education, Certifications & Training Minimum of an Associate's degree or diploma in Information Technology, Computer Science or a related field. Minimum of two (2) years' practical experience in technical support, helpdesk or systems support. Hands-on experience with Microsoft 365 administration and Active Directory. Working knowledge of Windows Server, VMware vSphere and Veeam Backup & Replication. CompTIA A+, Network+ or related industry certification would be an asset. Experience in a Managed Service Provider (MSP) environment and familiarity with ticketing and remote support tools would be advantageous. Ref: ICSL_TSE_082 Apply Now
